name: Taming the Beast
summary: In Durotar, Taming the Beast tests a young Horde hunter's skill with wild creatures. Thotar in Razor Hill guides the hunter through one last trial: taming a dangerous armored scorpid. Success brings the ability to tame, call, and dismiss a lasting companion.

sections.title: The Final Trial
sections.body: Before a hunter can travel Kalimdor with an animal companion, they must prove they can command Durotar's harsh wildlife. Thotar, the hunter trainer in Razor Hill, sends trainees to subdue three kinds of creature with an enchanted taming rod. After facing dire boars and swift surf crawlers, they must now tame an armored scorpid, a venomous predator protected by heavy plates and known for resilience and speed.

sections.title: Bonding with the Wild
sections.body: Taming an armored scorpid tests a hunter's focus and control under attack, not their skill at killing. Thotar urges hunters to match the beast's quick, confident strikes. Once the hunter has charmed the scorpid, they return to Razor Hill and give the taming rod back to Thotar. That return completes the trial, and Thotar then teaches the wild's innate techniques, letting the hunter seek out and bind a permanent companion of their choosing.

faq.q: What creature do I need to tame for this trial?
faq.answer: For this trial, tame an armored scorpid with Thotar's taming rod. The creature roams Durotar's arid red crags.

faq.q: Do I get to keep the armored scorpid after finishing the quest?
faq.answer: No. The armored scorpid is only a temporary companion and vanishes when you return the taming rod. Completing the trial teaches you to tame the wild beast of your choice permanently.

faq.q: Who initiates this rite of passage?
faq.answer: Thotar, the hunter trainer in Razor Hill in central Durotar, oversees this rite for young orc and troll hunters.

faq.q: Why does Thotar want hunters to tame an armored scorpid specifically?
faq.answer: Thotar sees the armored scorpid as a model for its confident, swift strikes and resilience. Taming such a dangerous predator proves a hunter can command wild beasts.

faq.q: What skills do you learn upon completing this quest?
faq.answer: You learn Tame Beast, Call Pet, and Dismiss Pet.
After learning to tame and call a companion, you can follow Thotar's direction to Training the Beast, where you learn to feed and command your ally.

angles.text: As a hunter, this rite marks an early milestone and grants you the core skills to tame, call, and command animal companions.
As a Horde youth in Durotar, you face its harshest predators to earn a place among the faction's scouts and providers.
As an orc, subduing Durotar's scorpids honors the belief that harsh terrain is overcome through unyielding will and martial discipline.
As a troll, you draw on keen instincts and a deep bond with wild spirits to pacify venomous predators that could strike others down.
